snapshot.title: FBI Notification: Orchard Standpipe Incident

fields.to: Denise Albrecht, Director of Water Operations; Luis Ferreira, Security & Emergency Manager; Hannah Weiss, City Communications Director
fields.subject: FW: FBI Notification — Orchard Standpipe Incident
fields.note: The FBI has been formally notified via secure line (555-034-1101) and has confirmed they are treating this as a potential malevolent act. They have instructed that no systems be reset or accessed until their forensic team arrives. They are sending a cyber-forensics unit to MBW-SCADA-SRV01 and MBW-FW-01 for evidence collection. They have asked for a full export of the historian trends, HMI audit logs, and PACS session recordings. All access to these systems must be blocked until further notice.
fields.signature:
Priya Nandakumar
SCADA / IT Security Manager

original.to: Priya Nandakumar, SCADA / IT Security Manager
original.subject: Formal Notification — Orchard Standpipe Incident
original.body:
This is an official notification from the FBI Cyber-Physical Division. The incident at the Orchard Standpipe site is under active investigation as a potential malevolent act. The FBI has assigned case number FBI-ORD-2025-0720-001. We have confirmed the chain of custody and have begun forensic acquisition of MBW-SCADA-SRV01 and MBW-FW-01. All system access must be suspended. We require the following exports:

- Full historian trend data (02:00–05:00) for RTU-02, PLC-02, and HMI-01
- HMI audit logs from MBW-HMI-01 (02:00–05:00)
- PACS session recordings from MBW-NVR-01 (02:00–05:00)
- RTU-02 event log (02:00–05:00), including ZS-612 and ZS-611

All exports must be delivered via encrypted USB drive to FBI Field Agent Elena Torres (555-037-9000) at the Orchard Standpipe site. Do not use email, cloud, or network transfer. All access to the control system and network must be blocked until further notice. This case is designated as a federal-level incident under CISA’s Critical Infrastructure Protection Protocol.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the FBI's formal involvement and enforces the chain-of-custody rules. Watch for any attempt to access MBW-HMI-01 or MBW-FW-01 after this point.
